method: Read-only source-informed design critique and correction diff review; no implementation/tests or actual data

findings_preserved.finding: Original nested envelope exposure contains inspected_xml_bytes, conflicting with new public no-content-length scope
findings_preserved.resolution: Original validators/instrumentation unchanged privately; new public envelope_exposure is a closed subset that omits byte counter and all undeclared fields.

findings_preserved.finding: UTF-8 decoding or preparse scanning can expose private text before XML parsing starts
findings_preserved.resolution: Separate started/completed UTF8 and XML states; MAY_HAVE_BEEN_DECODED set before first decode-and-scan attempt; preserve completed earlier exposure on later failure.

findings_preserved.finding: Default element text/tail handling and metadata multiplicity/order were unspecified
findings_preserved.resolution: Only declared opaque leaves accept text; all other element text and all tails allow XML whitespace only. Otherwise order/multiplicity are unconstrained within bounded child allowlists except explicit root/cell/row/merge rules; this does not claim full OOXML validity.

final_review_statement: Exposure accounting, public output restrictions and grammar defaults agree. The design remains one nonexecutable prospective stage, with production bindings unbound and scientific status BLOCKED_SCHEMA.
